notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI handles both wires (SMSG_INIT_WORLD_STATES -> ApplyInitialWorldStates, SMSG_UPDATE_WORLD_STATE -> ApplyWorldState) into a raw u32->u32 table and reproduces every deliberate semantic Benilla pinned: init performs upserts with no table clear (QuestWorldStateLaw.ApplyInit documents the unresolved-reference-call rationale), the (0,0) terminator is written as ordinary data, and the one consumer - the quest/NPC text $<n>w / $<n>e macros - reads a miss as 0, negates the key for $e via unchecked(0u - id), and formats through signed %d width (QuestTextMacroLaw.cs:39-48).
